sources.note: An L2-English perception study of six Odki-L1 undergraduates in Karachi; contains no description or data of Odki itself and cites no Odki source. Only unsourced typological asides: p.107 'South Asian languages, such as Odki, are mostly syllable-timed, i.e., syllables are equally timed and accented'; p.110 'Because the participants' native L1 (Odki) is syllable-timed and lacks the complex "jumping" stress of English, the learners adopt a simplified rule: when in doubt, stress the end.' Not a statement of where Odki word stress falls.
